text_en: “Who is this that comes from Edom, from Bozrah in garments stained crimson? Who is this so splendidly robed, marching in his great might? ” “It is I, announcing vindication, mighty to save. ”
text_cn: “那由厄东而来，身穿染红了的衣服，那由波责辣而来，衣着华丽，力量强大，阔步前进的是谁啊？”“是宣布正义，具有拯救大能的我。”

text_en: “Why are your robes red, and your garments like theirs who tread the wine press? ”
text_cn: “你的服装怎么成了红色，你的衣服好似一个踏酒醡（zhà）的呢？”

text_en: “I have trodden the wine press alone, and from the peoples no one was with me; I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my wrath; their juice spattered on my garments, and stained all my robes.
text_cn: “因为唯独我一人践踏了酒醡，我的人民中没有一个与我在一起。我在怒气中践踏了他们，我在怒火中蹂躏了他们，因此他们的血液溅到我的衣服上，我的服装就完全染污了。

text_en: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year for my redeeming work had come.
text_cn: 因为复仇的日子已在我心中，我施救的岁月已经来到。

text_en: I looked, but there was no helper; I stared, but there was no one to sustain me; so my own arm brought me victory, and my wrath sustained me.
text_cn: 我四下观看，但没有人辅助；我惊愕四顾，但没有人支持；因此惟有用我的手臂自行拯救，以我的怒气来支持自己。

text_en: I trampled down peoples in my anger, I crushed them in my wrath, and I poured out their lifeblood on the earth. ”
text_cn: 我在怒气中践踏了民众，我在怒火中粉碎了他们，使他们的鲜血流到地下。”

text_en: I will recount the gracious deeds of the Lord , the praiseworthy acts of the Lord , because of all that the Lord has done for us, and the great favor to the house of Israel that he has shown them according to his mercy, according to the abundance of his steadfast love.
text_cn: 我要依照上主以他的大慈大悲赐与我们的一切，和对以色列家所赐的宏福，称颂上主的慈惠和上主可赞颂的作为。

text_en: For he said, “Surely they are my people, children who will not deal falsely”; and he became their savior
text_cn: 他曾说过：“他们的确是我的百姓，不行虚伪的子民；”因此他成了他们一切困难中的拯救者。

text_en: in all their distress. It was no messenger or angel but his presence that saved them; in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; he lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.
text_cn: 并不是使者，也不是天使拯救他们，而是他自己。他以自己的爱情和怜悯赎回了他们；在往日，他时常扶持他们，怀抱他们。

text_en: But they rebelled and grieved his holy spirit; therefore he became their enemy; he himself fought against them.
text_cn: 但是他们成了叛徒，刺伤了他的圣神； 因此他变成了他们的敌人，亲自攻击他们。

text_en: Then they remembered the days of old, of Moses his servant. Where is the one who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is the one who put within them his holy spirit,
text_cn: 那时，他们想起古来的日子，想起他的仆人梅瑟。那引导羊群的牧者出离海洋的在哪里呢？那曾在他心中赋与自己圣神的在哪里呢？

text_en: who caused his glorious arm to march at the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to make for himself an everlasting name,
text_cn: 那在梅瑟右边以其荣耀的手臂，在百姓前分开海水，使自己获得永远声誉的在哪里呢？

text_en: who led them through the depths? Like a horse in the desert, they did not stumble.
text_cn: 那领导他们走过深渊，有如马行于旷野而不颠踬（zhì）的在哪里呢？

text_en: Like cattle that go down into the valley, the spirit of the Lord gave them rest. Thus you led your people, to make for yourself a glorious name.
text_cn: 上主的神怎样领导走兽下到山谷，你也怎样领导了你的百姓，好使你获得一个光荣的名号。

text_en: Look down from heaven and see, from your holy and glorious habitation. Where are your zeal and your might? The yearning of your heart and your compassion? They are withheld from me.
text_cn: 如今求你从天垂顾，从你光荣的圣所俯视！ 你的热爱，你的大能和你的同情心在哪里呢？求你不要停止你的慈悲，

text_en: For you are our father, though Abraham does not know us and Israel does not acknowledge us; you, O Lord , are our father; our Redeemer from of old is your name.
text_cn: 因为你是我们的父亲；亚巴郎虽不认识我们，以色列虽不记得我们， 你上主却是我们的父亲，“我们自古以来的救主”就是你的名。

text_en: Why, O Lord , do you make us stray from your ways and harden our heart, so that we do not fear you? Turn back for the sake of your servants, for the sake of the tribes that are your heritage.
text_cn: 上主！ 你为什么让我们离开你的道路？使我们的心变硬而不敬畏你？求你为了你的仆人，为了你产业的各支派，回心转意吧！

text_en: Your holy people took possession for a little while; but now our adversaries have trampled down your sanctuary.
text_cn: 你为什么让恶人践踏你的圣殿？为什么让我们的敌人蹂躏你的圣所？

text_en: We have long been like those whom you do not rule, like those not called by your name.
text_cn: 我们俨然成了一个从未受你治理，从未属你名下的民族。啊！ 望你冲破诸天降下，诸山在你面前震荡。
